item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem: Kabir lines up four samples on the science table. Which of these are behaving as liquids? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Ice cubes in a tray that keep a fixed shape.
options.B: Water poured into a bottle, taking the shape of the bottle and able to flow.
options.C: Cooking oil poured into a bottle, taking the shape of the bottle and able to flow.
options.D: The white mist above a boiling kettle, treated as liquid water because you can see it.

learn_by_solve.solve: Decide whether a mixture is homogeneous or heterogeneous from uniformity, visible particles, and settling.

followup.stem: Assign oxidation numbers first. The species is [[1]] if OS increases, [[2]] if OS decreases, or [[3]] if OS stays the same.
followup.why: A mixture with uniform composition throughout is homogeneous; a mixture that is not uniform, has visible particles, or settles with time is heterogeneous. This is the hinge move, not a reprint of the clicked option.
